theater: 多瑙河下游與高加索東線

battle.name: 俄土戰爭 (1877年-1878年)
battle.theater: 多瑙河下游與高加索東線
battle.brief: 一八七七年四月二十四日俄羅斯向奧斯曼帝國宣戰，兵分兩路：主力越過多瑙河攻入巴爾幹，北路沿高加索直取卡爾斯。普列文納的三次強攻折損上萬俄軍後，圍城轉為冬季機動，加特林機槍在土軍陣地前大量部署，壓住攻勢，最終以普列文納與卡爾斯先後陷落收場。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰的兩方是俄羅斯帝國與奧斯曼帝國，兩個體系在編制、兵役與補給上的差距，幾乎決定了戰役的樣貌。俄軍方面，亞歷山大二世沙皇以御前會議與軍務部主導動員，一八七七年二月起陸續徵召，總動員兵力約八十萬上下，軍隊編為以軍團為骨幹的野戰軍與獨立預備軍。巴爾幹戰線由大尼古拉·尼古拉耶維奇大公任總指揮，駐地設於布加勒斯特，下轄第一軍（佐托夫）、第二軍（古爾科）與預備軍，另有以托特列本為首的工程兵特別集團專司攻城；高加索方面設總督區，由米哈伊爾·尼古拉耶維奇大公統轄，洛里斯－梅利科夫指揮主力，另設梯弗里斯、埃爾祖魯姆與卡爾斯等地的要塞守備隊與地方徵召兵，後方有巴統至卡爾斯的鐵路連接。火器編配以俄軍一八七〇年式別丹步槍、師屬野戰砲與攻城砲為主，騎兵團與砲兵騎兵隊另配加特林機槍。奧斯曼方面，蘇丹阿卜杜勒哈米德二世與大維齊爾穆罕默德·阿里帕夏掌軍，軍隊沿用奧爾杜軍團制，分為尼札姆常備兵、雷迪夫補充兵與穆加夫民兵三類，軍官多為土耳其人，參謀部則大量聘請德國與奧地利軍事顧問，戈爾茨等人重整編制與操典，砲兵大量使用英製與德製後膛線膛砲。巴爾幹方面以魯塞克的第四軍為主，奧斯曼帕夏為總指揮；舒門、埃斯基賈拉與維丁各有分遣隊，阿卜杜勒卡迪爾貝伊守維丁，舒克魯帕夏掌希普卡一線，謝里夫帕夏則以西線阿爾巴尼亞與帖薩利為根據地。高加索方面由內迪姆帕夏、法赫里帕夏與梅齊德帕夏先後接掌，另有大量巴什巴祖克騎射非正規兵與地方民兵配合英製馬蒂尼步槍作戰。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire, and the gap between their two systems of organisation, manning and supply very nearly decided the character of the war. On the Russian side Emperor Alexander II directed the mobilisation through his council of state and the Ministry of War, and levies were called from February 1877 onwards; the total mobilisation came to something like eight hundred thousand men, organised into field armies built on a corps framework together with separate reserve armies. The Balkan theatre was commanded by Grand Duke Nicholas Nikolaevich, with his headquarters at Bucharest, and comprised the First Army under Zotov, the Second Army under Gurko and a reserve army, with a special engineer detachment under Totleben set aside for siege work. In the Caucasus a viceroyalty was established under Grand Duke Michael Nikolaevich, with Loris-Melikov commanding the main body, alongside the garrison commands and local levies at Tiflis, Erzurum and Kars; behind them the railway from Batumi to Kars tied the whole theatre together. The Russian armament was built on the 1870-pattern Berdan rifle, corps and divisional field guns and siege guns, with Gatling guns allotted to the cavalry and to the horse artillery. On the Ottoman side the army was under Sultan Abdul Hamid II and the grand vizier Mehmed Ali Pasha, and it kept the old ordu corps system divided into nizam regulars, redif reservists and mujaf militia; the officers were mostly Turkish, but the staff was staffed with a large number of German and Austrian military advisers, and men such as von der Goltz reorganised the establishment and the drill, while the artillery used large quantities of British and German breech-loading rifled guns. In the Balkans the Fourth Army at Rusçuk was the main body under Osman Pasha; there were separate detachments at Shumen, Eski Zagra and Vidin, with Abdülkadir Bey holding Vidin, Şükrü Pasha in charge of the Shipka line, and Sherif Pasha working from Albania and Thessaly in the west. In the Caucasus the command passed in turn through Nedim Pasha, Fahri Pasha and Mezid Pasha, with large numbers of bashi-bazouk irregular horsemen and local militia fighting alongside the regulars with British Martini rifles.
people: 關鍵人物分處兩國的指揮鏈上。俄國方面，亞歷山大二世批准開戰，但對戰果與克里米亞戰爭的敗績仍心存芥蒂；大尼古拉大公以最高統帥之尊坐鎮布加勒斯特，穩住巴爾幹的戰局；工程兵出身的托特列本自一八七七年七月起主持普列文納圍城，改用塹壕與地雷替代強攻，是俄軍技術轉向的代表人物；古爾科率第二軍在冬季越過洛姆河、攻取泰特文並切斷君士坦丁堡方向的交通；斯科別列夫在同年秋冬的攻勢中屢建戰功，其後接掌第一軍；佐托夫在第一次越過多瑙河與羅霍瓦的戰役中率第一軍；庫羅帕特金擔任第四軍軍長，參與洛佐瓦方向的戰鬥；高加索的洛里斯－梅利科夫以奇襲巴亞澤特、冬季攻取阿拉克與艾爾齊克再克卡爾斯聞名；外交方面，駐君士坦丁堡公使維特在一八七八年初的預備和約上取得成果卻被沙皇否決，外相戈爾查科夫則為柏林的冷遇所打擊。奧斯曼方面，蘇丹阿卜杜勒哈米德二世起初主戰，戰局不順時曾欲議和而為大維齊爾與軍方所阻；穆罕默德·阿里帕夏掌大維齊爾府，其後由拉烏夫帕夏接替；奧斯曼帕夏在普列文納以少數兵力拖住俄軍主力，被俘後成為北方最知名的戰俘；阿卜杜勒卡迪爾貝伊守維丁失利，舒克魯帕夏在希普卡山口被古爾科擊敗，謝里夫帕夏在西部屢挫俄軍。德國顧問戈爾茨整頓軍制並主持戰後改編，莫爾特克少將亦曾赴前線參觀並留下意見。國際層面，俾斯麥以「誠實的掮客」身分在柏林會議上調處，迪斯雷利代表英國、奧地利的安德拉斯西與俄國外相戈爾查科夫在會上互相試探，加里波第則率志願兵前往土耳其一方效命。
peopleEn: The decisive figures sat at both ends of the two chains of command. On the Russian side Alexander II gave his consent to the war, though he remained uneasy about the outcome and about the memory of the Crimean defeat; Grand Duke Nicholas sat as commander-in-chief at Bucharest and held the Balkan front steady; Totleben, who came out of the engineers, took over the siege of Plevna from July 1877 and replaced frontal assault with saps and mines, and was the representative of the Russian turn towards technical methods; Gurko led the Second Army across the Lom in the winter, took Teteven and cut the road towards Constantinople; Skobelev built his reputation in the campaigning of that autumn and winter and afterwards took command of the First Army; Zotov led the First Army in the first crossing of the Danube and in the fighting at Rahova; Kuropatkin commanded the Fourth Corps in the Lozova fighting. In the Caucasus Loris-Melikov became known for the raid on Bayazet, the winter operations on Alashkert and Aladzha, and the final reduction of Kars. On the diplomatic side Witte, the Russian envoy in Constantinople, won a preliminary agreement in early 1878 only to have it rejected by the tsar, while the foreign minister Gorchakov was bruised by the cold reception at Berlin. On the Ottoman side Sultan Abdul Hamid II was at first all for the war, and when it went badly showed a wish to negotiate that the grand vizier and the military establishment resisted; Mehmed Ali Pasha held the grand vizierate and was followed by Rauf Pasha. Osman Pasha held Plevna with a small force against the main Russian army, and as a prisoner became the best known captive in the north; Abdülkadir Bey lost Vidin, Şükrü Pasha was beaten at the Shipka pass by Gurko, and Sherif Pasha repeatedly checked the Russians in the west. The German adviser von der Goltz reorganised the army and directed its postwar reform, and the younger Moltke visited the front and left his comments. At the international level Bismarck acted as the honest broker at the Congress of Berlin, Disraeli spoke for Britain, Andrássy for Austria and Gorchakov for Russia as they probed one another in the hall, and Garibaldi took a body of volunteers to serve on the Ottoman side.
kits: 加特林機槍在這場戰爭裡不是試驗品，而是俄軍野戰與守備的制式配備。俄國早在一八七〇年代初便向美國廠商大批訂購這型手轉多管速射武器，數量以萬計，常見記載接近兩萬挺，具體門數各家說法互有出入；到一八七七年，卡面所繪的六管原型已讓位於十管改型，後者以人力轉動，理論射速可達每分鐘數百發，實際連發時多在一百發上下，需四至六人操槍並配專用砲車與彈藥箱，另有以馬匹帶動的改型供砲兵騎兵隊使用。俄軍把它編入騎兵與步兵師屬的機槍連，集中使用在突破土軍密集陣線、封鎖要塞火力點與掩護工兵架橋三種場合；普列文納外圍與希普卡山口的攻勢中都有加特林機槍的戰記，而高加索方面，攻取卡爾斯時的攻城砲隊與擔任警戒的分隊同樣配發。步槍方面，俄軍使用一八七〇年式別丹步槍，是美國皮博迪步槍的俄製改型，採手動槍機；土軍使用英製馬蒂尼－亨利步槍，膛線與精度勝於俄軍尚存的舊式滑膛槍，後膛裝填亦在普及。火砲是決定攻城成敗的關鍵：俄軍以克魯普鋼廠所製的野戰砲與攻城砲攻擊城壘，土軍則在普列文納與卡爾斯以大量野戰砲和守備砲組成交叉火網，攻城與守城雙方都需要新式後膛線膛砲。騎兵在巴爾幹退居次要，在高加索卻用來打游擊與追擊；兩軍的運輸主要靠馬車、騾車與土軍的駱駝隊，巴爾幹戰線靠瓦納、魯塞克與舒門方向的陸路和黑海航運，高加索戰線則靠一八七五年通車的巴統至梯弗里斯、卡爾斯鐵路，另有野戰電報線把命令從後方直送前線。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun was not an experiment in this war but a standard fitting of the Russian field army and of the garrison artillery. Russia had been placing large orders for this hand-cranked multi-barrel rapid-fire weapon with American manufacturers as early as the beginning of the 1870s, in numbers running to tens of thousands, the figure most often given being close to twenty thousand, though the exact count differs from source to source. By 1877 the six-barrel prototype shown on the card had given way to the ten-barrel pattern, turned by hand, with a theoretical rate of fire of several hundred rounds a minute and a practical rate nearer a hundred rounds a minute in sustained firing, worked by four to six men and served on a special carriage with its ammunition boxes; there were also horse-turned variants for the horse batteries. The Russians formed them into machine-gun companies attached to the cavalry and to the infantry divisions, and used them in three roles: breaking massed Ottoman infantry, silencing the fire of fortress guns and covering the engineers at their bridging work. There are records of Gatling guns in the operations outside Plevna and at the Shipka pass, and in the Caucasus the besieging artillery at Kars and the covering detachments were similarly equipped. For small arms the Russians carried the 1870-pattern Berdan rifle, a Russian adaptation of the American Peabody arm with a manually operated bolt; the Ottomans used the British Martini-Henry, whose rifling and accuracy were better than the old smoothbore stocks the Russians still had, and the breech-loading turn was spreading among the Turkish ranks. Artillery decided the sieges: the Russians brought up field and siege guns from the Krupp works, while the Ottomans at Plevna and Kars built interlocking grids of field and garrison guns, and both sides of a siege needed modern breech-loading rifled pieces. Cavalry played a minor part in the Balkans but was used for raids and pursuit in the Caucasus. Transport rested mainly on wagons, mule teams and the Ottoman camel caravans; the Balkan theatre drew its supplies by the land routes and the Black Sea shipping behind Varna, Rusçuk and Shumen, and the Caucasus theatre on the railway from Batumi through Tiflis to Kars, opened in 1875, while field telegraph lines carried orders straight from the rear to the front.
tactics: 巴爾幹戰線的戰術主軸，是攻城技術與補給線的競賽。普列文納的土軍陣地由奧斯曼帕夏依據兩翼高地修築，前面是深溝與削壁，兩座土制碉堡和密集野戰砲控制通往君士坦丁堡的道路，後方直通往首都方向；俄軍在七月九日試圖強行突破即告失敗，此後又在七月二十日、八月三十日與九月九日三次正面強攻，屢次付出重大代價仍未能奪下。托特列本接手後改用塹壕對掘、地雷爆破與逐段包圍，把攻勢轉為工程對工程；真正的破局來自迂迴：俄軍在冬季的天氣下仍向阿爾巴尼亞方向與洛姆河上游分進，切斷守軍與君士坦丁堡的聯絡線，又在希普卡山口反覆爭奪，使土軍無法把援軍與糧彈送上戰場。一八七八年一月九日至十一日古爾科所部攻入希普卡，奧斯曼帕夏遂於十日放棄普列文納。卡爾斯圍城則是另一種樣貌：俄軍以重砲與地雷慢慢削壞要塞外廓，同時以夜襲壓制守軍屢次出城反擊，最終在援軍斷絕、糧秣告罄的情況下於一月三日開城，俘虜以萬計。高加索的機動作戰以洛里斯－梅利科夫的奇襲為代表，他以小縱隊突入奧斯曼軍縱深，奪取巴亞澤特與艾爾齊克，又在阿拉克的冬季戰役中打散敵軍，迫使土軍放棄卡爾斯外圍陣地。加特林機槍在這些作戰中主要負責封鎖通道、對付密集衝鋒與掩護正面，讓土軍以人海戰術投入的優勢難以發揮。
tacticsEn: The Balkan theatre turned on a race between siege technique and the supply line. Osman Pasha's position at Plevna was built on the two flanking heights, with ditches and scarps in front, two earth redoubts and a mass of field guns commanding the road to Constantinople, and its rear directly open in that direction. The Russian attempt to force the position on 9 July failed at once, and three further frontal attacks on 20 July, 30 August and 9 September each cost heavily and achieved nothing. Totleben then changed the character of the business, using saps, mines and a closing blockade to turn the attack into engineering against engineering. The real break came from the flanking movement: in the winter the Russians drove towards Albania and up the Lom, cutting the link between the garrison and Constantinople, and they fought repeatedly for the Shipka pass so that the Ottomans could not bring up reinforcements and food to the field. When Gurko's men took the Shipka on 9 to 11 January 1878, Osman Pasha gave up Plevna on the 10th. The siege of Kars was of another kind: the Russians worked at the outer works slowly with heavy guns and mines and punished the sorties of the garrison, and the fortress finally opened on 3 January when the relieving column could no longer come and the food had run out, giving up a prisoner count in the thousands. In the Caucasus the pattern of war was the raid: Loris-Melikov drove a small column into the Ottoman rear, took Bayazet and Aladzha, and broke the enemy in the winter fighting at Alashkert, forcing the Ottomans to abandon the outer positions before Kars. Through all of this the Gatling guns were used to seal passages, to meet massed assaults and to cover the advance, denying the Ottomans the benefit of the numbers they put into the attack.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。俄軍總動員約八十萬上下，巴爾幹戰線的野戰兵力約三十萬至四十萬，高加索方面約十萬；土軍巴爾幹方面的理論編制常被列到五十萬以上，實際能投入野戰的約二十萬，高加索方面約四萬至五萬。普列文納守軍約二萬五千人，配野戰砲與守備砲約三十門；俄軍七月九日首次強攻即損失逾八千人，九月九日第三次強攻的損失更達一萬二千至一萬五千人，整個圍城期間俄軍傷亡合計約三萬。土軍在普列文納投降時被俘約兩萬人，希普卡山口最後一次戰鬥再被俘一萬餘人，卡爾斯開城時被俘亦有一萬五千至兩萬人。全戰的總損失，各家估算出入頗大：俄軍陣亡常被估在兩萬上下、傷病逾五萬；土軍陣亡與失蹤多估在數萬之間，另有大量被俘者遣返或改編為補充兵。時間上，開戰在一八七七年四月二十四日，實際跨越多瑙河在六月下旬，普列文納陷落在一八七八年一月十日，卡爾斯陷落在一月三日，列強的介入談判集中在上半年，柏林會議於一八七八年六月十三日開幕，正式和約要到一八七九年九月九日。距離方面，瓦納至普列文納的公路約一百二十公里，卡爾斯距梯弗里斯約二百八十公里，鐵路正是靠這段連線把物資送進高加索戰區。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Russian mobilisation was on the order of eight hundred thousand men; the field armies in the Balkans numbered some three to four hundred thousand, and those in the Caucasus about one hundred thousand. The theoretical establishment of the Ottoman forces in the Balkans is often given as over five hundred thousand, while the number actually able to fight in the field was nearer two hundred thousand, with forty to fifty thousand in the Caucasus. The garrison of Plevna was about twenty-five thousand men with some thirty field and garrison guns. The first Russian assault on 9 July cost over eight thousand men, and the third assault on 9 September from twelve to fifteen thousand, the Russian casualties over the whole siege coming to about thirty thousand. When Plevna surrendered about twenty thousand Ottomans were taken prisoner; the last fight at the Shipka pass yielded another ten thousand, and the surrender of Kars between fifteen and twenty thousand more. The totals for the war as a whole vary widely from source to source: Russian dead are commonly put at around twenty thousand with more than fifty thousand wounded and sick, while Ottoman dead and missing are estimated in the tens of thousands, with a further large body of prisoners returned or absorbed into the reserve units. In time, the war was declared on 24 April 1877, the crossing of the Danube came in late June, Kars fell on 3 January 1878 and Plevna on 10 January, the intervention negotiations of the Great Powers ran through the first half of that year, the Congress of Berlin opened on 13 June 1878, and the formal peace treaty was not signed until 9 September 1879. In distance, the road from Varna to Plevna is about one hundred and twenty kilometres, and Kars stands roughly two hundred and eighty from Tiflis; it was along that last line that the railway fed the Caucasus theatre.
cause: 起因是「東方問題」在歐洲列強的縱容下被推到了戰爭門檻。一八五六年《巴黎條約》雖確認了奧斯曼帝國的完整，並把它納入歐洲協約體系，但俄國從未放棄對黑海與巴爾幹的訴求；一八五三至一八五六年的克里米亞戰爭讓俄國的南向擴張受挫，此後二十年間俄國以泛斯拉夫主義在巴爾幹擴張影響，敘利亞、克里米亞與高加索的戰略位置始終是核心。一八七〇年代奧斯曼帝國財政枯竭、軍制陳舊，克里特、波斯尼亞、保加利亞與塞爾維亞相繼起事，一八七六年的君士坦丁堡會議在列強無法約束俄國的狀況下流產；德國完成統一後的歐洲格局更使俄國得以放手一搏。俄國的具體要求是撤廢一八五六年條約中關於黑海中立的部分、讓巴爾干自主，並把俄國勢力伸入黑海海峽；一八七六年的萊希斯塔特密約使奧地利默許俄國在巴爾幹擴張，一八七七年三月二十一日的《倫敦議定書》雖由六國與土耳其共同簽署，卻未能約束俄軍的徵召。直接導火線是俄國在一八七七年春夏的動員，以及土耳其拒絕接受俄方對新條約草案的照會；土耳其同時封鎖黑海海峽、扣押俄國商船並驅逐俄使，四月二十四日俄國宣戰，戰爭自此爆發。
causeEn: The cause was the Eastern Question pushed to the threshold of war under the indulgence of the European Great Powers. The Treaty of Paris of 1856 confirmed the integrity of the Ottoman Empire and admitted it into the European concert, but Russia never abandoned its claims on the Black Sea and the Balkans; the Crimean War of 1853 to 1856 checked the Russian advance to the south, and over the twenty years that followed Russia extended its influence through the Balkans under the banner of pan-Slavism, with Syria, the Crimea and the Caucasus remaining the strategic core of the quarrel. In the 1870s the Ottoman Empire was financially ruined and its army obsolete, with revolts in Crete, Bosnia, Bulgaria and Serbia, and the Constantinople Conference of 1876 broke up because the Powers could not hold Russia in check; a united Germany in the European settlement gave Russia room to move. What Russia demanded was the abrogation of the Black Sea clauses of the 1856 treaty, autonomy for the Balkan peoples and a Russian grip on the Straits. The Reichstadt agreement of 1876 gave Austria's tacit consent to Russian expansion in the Balkans, and the London Protocol of 21 March 1877, though signed by the six Powers together with Turkey, could not restrain the Russian mobilisation. The immediate trigger was the Russian mobilisation through the spring and summer of 1877 and the Ottoman refusal to accept the Russian note on the draft of a new treaty; Constantinople closed the Straits to Russian shipping, detained Russian merchant vessels and expelled the Russian envoy, and on 24 April Russia declared war.
impact: 影響首先是俄國的挫敗與歐洲均勢的重排。俄軍在巴爾幹靠冬季迂迴取勝、在高加索攻克卡爾斯，卻在《聖斯特凡諾條約》之後被柏林會議大幅刪改：保加利亞的版圖被切小、海峽通行權被列為國際規則，俄國得到的實際戰果遠低於戰場上的勝利，這一落差成為其後二十餘年俄國在巴爾幹與近東擴張的心理障礙，也是「東方問題」在第一次世界大戰前始終未解的源頭。對奧斯曼帝國而言這是一場生存戰：它保住了君士坦丁堡與巴爾幹的核心，卻失去了塞爾維亞、蒙特內哥羅、羅馬尼亞的宗主地位與巴爾干部分領土，國庫的崩潰促使朝廷推行一八七六年憲法與議會，並延攬德國軍事顧問重整軍制，軍隊的編制、操典與後膛砲在隨後十年間被全面換裝。另一層長遠影響落在軍事技術上：普列文納的強攻失利使俄國深切體會到密集火力的威力與攻城砲的不足，軍械發展的重心隨之轉向速射武器與重砲，這條線索在一八七〇至九〇年代的加特林採購與一八八〇年代以後的連發武器研究上顯現，最終推動俄國自製機槍。技術之外，本戰的戰俘、戰報與外國顧問的記述在歐洲廣為流傳，普列文納從此成為歐洲軍事學院講授攻堅戰術的標準案例，而羅霍瓦、洛佐瓦與希普卡山口的名稱也進入各國軍校的教材。
impactEn: The first effect was Russia's disappointment and a rearrangement of the European balance. The Russians had won in the Balkans by a winter flanking movement and had taken Kars in the Caucasus, yet the Congress of Berlin cut back the Treaty of San Stefano severely: Bulgaria was reduced in size and the freedom of the Straits was converted into an international rule, so that what Russia actually gained was far less than what it had won on the field. That disappointment became an obstacle in Russian expansion in the Balkans and the Near East for the following twenty-odd years, and it is the root of the Eastern Question that remained unsolved until the First World War. For the Ottoman Empire it was a war for survival: the capital and the core of the Balkans were kept, but the suzerainty over Serbia, Montenegro and Romania and a slice of the Balkan territories were lost, and the collapse of the treasury pushed the Porte towards the constitution and the parliament of 1876 and towards the employment of German military advisers to reform the army, with the establishment, the drill and the breech-loading guns all being replaced over the following decade. A further long-term effect fell on military technology: the failure of the assaults at Plevna taught the Russians the power of concentrated fire and the inadequacy of their siege artillery, and the centre of weight in their armaments development shifted towards rapid-fire weapons and heavy guns. That thread shows in the Russian purchases of Gatling guns through the 1870s and 1890s and in the study of repeating weapons after 1880, and it eventually pushed the Russians towards a weapon of their own. Beyond the technology, the prisoners, the dispatches and the reports of foreign observers circulated widely across Europe, Plevna became the standard case study of siege operations in the military academies, and the names of Rahova, Lozova and the Shipka pass entered the textbooks of the armies of the world.
result: 結果是俄軍在戰場上取勝、在外交上受挫。一八七八年一月三日卡爾斯開城、一月十日普列文納投降，奧斯曼帕夏以下兩萬人成為俘虜，俄軍推進至阿德里安堡與君士坦丁堡外圍；同年三月初簽訂的《聖斯特凡諾條約》給了俄國巴統、卡爾斯與阿爾達汗，並把巴爾干置於一個由俄國實際支配的大保加利亞之下。列強無法接受，六月十三日至七月十三日的柏林會議把方案推翻：保加利亞被壓回舊界，奧斯曼保住博斯普魯斯與達達尼爾的主權完整，卻失去了對塞爾維亞、蒙特內哥羅與羅馬尼亞的宗主地位，《海峽公約》則把黑海海峽的通航權交由國際規則管理，一八八〇年生效。戰爭的正式結束要到一八七八年一月十九日的停戰協議與一八七九年九月九日的《君士坦丁堡條約》，其後雙方交換俘虜、俄軍逐步撤出，戰線回到新的俄土邊界與高加索分界線上。對加特林機槍而言，這一戰確立了速射武器在野戰與攻城中的地位：它們被證明能壓制密集步兵與掩護正面，隨後在歐洲各國的軍火市場上持續擴張，成為十九世紀末軍械更新的常備選項。
resultEn: The result was a Russian victory on the field and a Russian disappointment in the diplomacy. Kars opened on 3 January 1878 and Plevna surrendered on the 10th, with Osman Pasha and some twenty thousand men going into captivity, and the Russian armies pushed forward to the approaches of Adrianople and Constantinople. The Treaty of San Stefano, signed in the first days of March 1878, gave Russia Batumi, Kars and Ardahan and set up a Greater Bulgaria under Russian actual control in the Balkans. The Great Powers could not accept it, and the Congress of Berlin, which sat from 13 June to 13 July, threw the scheme out: Bulgaria was cut back to its old borders, the Ottomans kept the full sovereignty of the Bosporus and the Dardanelles while losing their suzerainty over Serbia, Montenegro and Romania, and the Convention of the Straits put the passage of the Black Sea straits under international rules, taking effect in 1880. The formal end of the war came with the armistice of 19 January 1878 and the Treaty of Constantinople of 9 September 1879, after which prisoners were exchanged and the Russians withdrew by degrees, and the front returned to the new Russo-Ottoman line and to the Caucasus frontier. For the Gatling gun the war fixed the standing of the rapid-fire weapon in the field and at the siege: it was proved able to hold down massed infantry and to cover an advance, and it went on expanding in the European arms market, becoming a standing option in the rearmament of the late nineteenth century.
